name: Lady Ana
description: A trainer in Liliana's youth with the Forward Order.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls how her attempt to heal Josu raised him as an undead who killed Lady Ana before she fled as her spark ignited (flashback).
timeline.quote: She had meant only to heal him, and instead turned him into a mindless undead monster that killed Lady Ana, killed her servants

timeline.summary: Professor Onyx grades exams and recalls her strict mentor Lady Ana.
timeline.quote: Professor Serafina Onyx blew air at the flame, causing it to dance.

pages_say.description: Liliana's mother, killed by the undead Josu.
A strict healing mentor whose life ended in betrayal.
A trainer in Liliana's youth with the Forward Order.
